root: ^Bartolomeu: Loras... is that truly you, old friend?
^Loras: Aye. A bit lighter these days — missing the head and the rest — but still a helmet all the same.
^Bartolomeu: Ha! I suppose the drink I owe you wouldn’t do either of us much good now... we’re both a liver short, it seems.
^Cacildes: Bartolomeu... do you know where we can find the entrance to the Impossible City?
^Bartolomeu: Ah - the Impossible City. So many have sought it. None have returned. So... you're finally prepared to face Vella...
^Bartolomeu: You must make way to the ruined bridge. Something there has awoken me... and you know I'm not easily disturbed.
^Bartolomeu: Good luck. I’d suggest wearing Loras’s helmet if you’ve none of your own — though I imagine he’d object.
^Loras: You’ve got that right! I’m not sitting on another head crawling with lice.
